# docker_container (List Resource)

Lists containers on the provider's Docker host as `docker_container` resources, for `terraform query` and bulk import. Every container is listed (running or not) unless `all = false`; filters map to the Engine API `GET /containers/json` filters.

List resources require Terraform 1.14 or later. Declare `list "docker_container" "<name>"`
blocks in a `*.tfquery.hcl` file and run `terraform query`
(`-generate-config-out=<file>.tf` writes import blocks and configuration for
the results). Arguments go in the list block's `config` block.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Run with `terraform query` (Terraform 1.14+); add `-generate-config-out=imports.tf`
# to write import blocks and resource configuration for what is found.
provider "docker" {}

list "docker_container" "web" {
  provider = docker

  config {
    status = "running"
    labels = { app = "web" }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `all` (Boolean) List stopped containers too. Default `true`; `false` lists only running containers, like `docker ps`.
- `ancestor` (String) Only containers created from this image (name, name:tag, ID or a descendant of it).
- `labels` (Map of String) Only containers carrying every one of these labels. An empty value matches any value of that label key.
- `name` (String) Only containers whose name matches, using the Engine API `name` filter (substring or prefix match, as the daemon defines it).
- `network` (String) Only containers connected to this network (name or ID).
- `status` (String) Only containers in this state: `created`, `restarting`, `running`, `removing`, `paused`, `exited` or `dead`.
